name: 73117 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73117 (Oklahoma City) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73117 (Oklahoma City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
58% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 73117 (Oklahoma City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 64% of all organizations here have no identified type.
